title: Cards — the same screens four ways

steps.headline: Your Library: which card look is best here?
steps.notice: Look at: Plugin cards. Today they carry a big shadow. Only the cards change; every version already uses Round corners and a 12px gap between cards.

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: Today's mix, already with the Round corners you picked.

variants.label: Raised
variants.summary: Every card: panel color, thin border and a soft shadow.

variants.label: Outlined
variants.summary: Every card: panel color and a thin border, no shadow.

variants.label: Filled
variants.summary: Every card: a lightly tinted fill, no border, no shadow.

steps.risk: Picking differently on different screens is a real answer: it tells the guide which kinds of cards should stand out and which should stay quiet.
